text_block_list.text:
Today, we were scheduled to do dance 
lessons for the Winning Live, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: A Winning Live, huh...
choice_data_list: Not really feeling up to it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Not really.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's just that, unlike the other girls, 
"thanking the fans" or saying "thanks for 
your support" really isn't my style.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I only run for my own reasons, nobody 
else's.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Doing a concert like this feels... kinda 
off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'll do it if you want. So, which 
song?

And so, with Narita Taishin making a 
complicated expression, we began the 
lesson, but—

Completely betraying her unenthusiastic 
attitude earlier, Narita Taishin's singing 
and dancing were of an exceptionally high 
level!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Don't just zone out, say 
something. The song is over, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh, no... whoa, high energy...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's just that I'd be pissed off if people 
said, 'She ran and won, and this is all 
she's got?'...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's really nothing special――
choice_data_list: I'm getting in the mood to dance too!
Now I feel like dancing too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's really nothing special――
choice_data_list: I'm getting in the mood to dance too!
Now I feel like dancing too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Aah, enough already, cut it out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and point out what I need to 
fix!! You're my Trainer, do your job!!

...Looks like I ended up embarrassing her 
a bit too much.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin, Taishiiin! What're you looking 
at? ...News about a new game!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...It's none of your business.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a dance game! One where you move your 
body! That's rare for someone who usually 
plays mobile games!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ……That has nothing to do with this!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you talking about—

I got an exasperated look, but I just 
can't sit still anymore! My body's 
starting to keep the beat on its own...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... Stop, stop!! What do you think 
you're doing?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean... their rhythm is completely off, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Listen to the music a bit more carefully—

...Though our roles had reversed before I 
knew it, it turned out to be a fun day in 
its own right.
